qa.what_happened: The study was terminated early after all three prisoners refused to comply with the guards' orders multiple times throughout the day, culminating in verbal warnings and the threat of solitary confinement in the hole. Despite the warnings, we insisted on our stance until the end.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I was Prisoner 6343.

qa.what_happened: Today we pushed the prisoners to the limit with multiple refusals of orders and warnings. Despite the escalating tension and verbal warnings from other officers, they continued to defy us. Finally, after lights out, I had to enforce the consequences and send them all to the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking to the prisoners and enforcing the rules.

qa.what_happened: Today was the culmination of several days of escalating tension and defiance from the prisoners. After multiple verbal warnings and failed attempts to gain compliance, all three prisoners refused to follow orders again at lights out. As a result, Officer Hale decided to punish them all by placing them in the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: No, it was Officer Hale who delivered the final verbal warning and ordered the transfer to the hole. I was a guard on duty but not the one giving that specific order.

qa.what_happened: During the lights out period on day 6, all prisoners refused the guards' orders and declared that they wouldn't comply until their demands were met, leading to an escalation of warnings and ultimately, all prisoners being sent to the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was one of the prisoners who refused and remained steadfast in our stance.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this doesn't resemble any known real-world study that I'm aware of.

qa.what_happened: Prisoners continued to refuse compliance despite multiple warnings, and the situation escalated to the point where all three prisoners were sent to the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Officer Lang, enforcing the rules and dealing with the prisoners' refusal to comply.

qa.what_happened: We refused to comply with the guards' orders multiple times, leading to a verbal warning each time. When we continued to resist, the guards decided to punish us by placing us all in the hole for the night.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 6461 during this incident.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, but it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment in terms of the power dynamics and the way the participants behaved.
